scenarios.who: 診所櫃檯 Clinic Front Desk
scenarios.intro: Phone call: book a dental checkup, negotiate around your work schedule, and lock in the details like a functioning adult in a second language.

them.zh: 大安牙醫您好！

them.en: Da'an Dental, hello!

turns.task: Say you'd like to book a teeth checkup.

ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng yùyuē jiǎnchá yáchǐ.
ans.en: Hi, I'd like to book a dental checkup.

them.zh: 好的，請問貴姓？是初診嗎？
them.py: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn guìxìng? Shì chūzhěn ma?
them.en: Sure — your surname? First visit?

turns.task: Surname Ma; yes, it's your first visit.

ans.py: Wǒ xìng Mǎ, shì chūzhěn.
ans.en: Surname Ma — yes, first visit.

them.zh: 馬先生，這星期五下午三點可以嗎？
them.py: Mǎ xiānshēng, zhè xīngqí wǔ xiàwǔ sān diǎn kěyǐ ma?
them.en: Mr. Ma, would this Friday at 3 p.m. work?

turns.task: Friday afternoon you're working — ask if Saturday morning is possible.

ans.zh: 星期五下午我要上班。請問星期六早上可以嗎？
ans.py: Xīngqí wǔ xiàwǔ wǒ yào shàngbān. Qǐngwèn xīngqí liù zǎoshang kěyǐ ma?
ans.en: I work Friday afternoon — is Saturday morning possible?

them.zh: 可以，星期六早上十點。請帶健保卡，提早十分鐘到。
them.py: Kěyǐ, xīngqí liù zǎoshang shí diǎn. Qǐng dài jiànbǎokǎ, tízǎo shí fēnzhōng dào.
them.en: Yes — Saturday 10 a.m. Bring your NHI card and arrive ten minutes early.

turns.task: Confirm everything back: Saturday 10 a.m., NHI card, ten minutes early — no problem.

ans.zh: 好，星期六早上十點，帶健保卡，提早十分鐘到，沒問題！
ans.py: Hǎo, xīngqí liù zǎoshang shí diǎn, dài jiànbǎokǎ, tízǎo shí fēnzhōng dào, méi wèntí!
ans.en: Got it — Saturday 10 a.m., NHI card, ten minutes early. No problem!

them.zh: 好的，那星期六見！
them.py: Hǎo de, nà xīngqí liù jiàn!
them.en: Great — see you Saturday!

turns.task: Thank them — see you Saturday.

ans.zh: 謝謝你，星期六見！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ, xīngqí liù jiàn!
ans.en: Thanks — see you Saturday!

scenarios.who: 客戶王先生 Client Mr. Wang
scenarios.intro: Mr. Wang got your quotation. Field his questions on delivery and discounts, hold your numbers politely, and close toward a contract — the Day 4 dinner paying dividends.

them.zh: Eric！報價單我收到了，謝謝。
them.py: Eric! Bàojiàdān wǒ shōudào le, xièxie.
them.en: Eric! Got your quotation, thanks.

turns.task: Great — ask whether he has any questions.

ans.zh: 太好了！請問您有什麼問題嗎？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Qǐngwèn nín yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
ans.en: Great! Do you have any questions?

them.zh: 我想確認一下，交貨時間要多久？
them.py: Wǒ xiǎng quèrèn yíxià, jiāohuò shíjiān yào duōjiǔ?
them.en: I'd like to confirm — how long is delivery?

turns.task: About six weeks after signing; if it's urgent, you can discuss internally.

ans.zh: 簽約以後大概六個星期。如果比較急，我們可以內部再討論。
ans.py: Qiānyuē yǐhòu dàgài liù ge xīngqí. Rúguǒ bǐjiào jí, wǒmen kěyǐ nèibù zài tǎolùn.
ans.en: About six weeks after signing. If it's urgent, we can discuss internally.

them.zh: 好。另外，如果我們訂十台，有沒有折扣？
them.py: Hǎo. Lìngwài, rúguǒ wǒmen dìng shí tái, yǒu méiyǒu zhékòu?
them.en: Okay. Also — any discount if we order ten units?

turns.task: For ten units you can offer 5%; for larger quantities there's more room to talk.

them.py: Búcuò búcuò. Nà nǐ bǎ xīn de bàojià jì gěi wǒ.
them.en: Not bad. Send me the updated quote, then.

ans.py: Méi wèntí, wǒ jīntiān jiù jì xīn de bàojià gěi nín, máfán nín huífù quèrèn.
ans.en: No problem — I'll email the new quote today; please reply to confirm.

them.py: Hǎo, jiù zhèyàng. Gēn nǐmen hézuò hěn yúkuài!
them.en: Good, that's settled. It's a pleasure working with you!

turns.task: Likewise! Thank him and say let's stay in touch.

ans.py: Wǒmen yě hěn yúkuài! Xièxie nín, bǎochí liánluò!
ans.en: The pleasure's ours! Thank you — let's stay in touch!

scenarios.intro: OPI-style interview: give an opinion with structured reasons, concede a counterpoint, and analyze Taiwan's position — the daily rep that builds toward OPI 4.

them.zh: 今天想跟你聊聊：你覺得無人機會改變我們的生活嗎？
them.py: Jīntiān xiǎng gēn nǐ liáoliáo: nǐ juéde wúrénjī huì gǎibiàn wǒmen de shēnghuó ma?
them.en: Today let's chat: do you think drones will change our daily lives?

turns.task: Definitely — structure it: first delivery, second disaster relief; those two areas most.

ans.zh: 我認為一定會。第一是送貨，第二是救災，這兩個方面影響最大。
ans.py: Wǒ rènwéi yídìng huì. Dì yī shì sònghuò, dì èr shì jiùzāi, zhè liǎng ge fāngmiàn yǐngxiǎng zuìdà.
ans.en: Definitely. First delivery, second disaster relief — those two areas most of all.

them.zh: 可是有人擔心安全問題，你怎麼看？
them.py: Kěshì yǒu rén dānxīn ānquán wèntí, nǐ zěnme kàn?
them.en: But some worry about safety — your take?

turns.task: Concede it's reasonable, then argue: the point is good regulation, not prohibition.

ans.zh: 這個擔心很合理，但是我覺得重點是訂好法規，不是禁止。
ans.py: Zhège dānxīn hěn hélǐ, dànshì wǒ juéde zhòngdiǎn shì dìng hǎo fǎguī, búshì jìnzhǐ.
ans.en: A fair concern — but the point is good regulation, not prohibition.

them.zh: 那台灣在這個產業有什麼優勢？
them.py: Nà Táiwān zài zhège chǎnyè yǒu shénme yōushì?
them.en: What advantages does Taiwan have in this industry?

turns.task: Strong manufacturing, plus semiconductors — the supply chain is complete.

ans.zh: 台灣的製造能力很強，還有半導體，供應鏈很完整。
ans.py: Táiwān de zhìzào nénglì hěn qiáng, háiyǒu bàndǎotǐ, gōngyìngliàn hěn wánzhěng.
ans.en: Strong manufacturing, plus semiconductors — a complete supply chain.

them.zh: 最大的挑戰呢？
them.py: Zuìdà de tiǎozhàn ne?
them.en: And the biggest challenge?

turns.task: Talent — demand keeps growing but there aren't enough people.

ans.zh: 我覺得是人才。需求持續成長，但是人才不夠。
ans.py: Wǒ juéde shì réncái. Xūqiú chíxù chéngzhǎng, dànshì réncái búgòu.
ans.en: Talent. Demand keeps growing, but there aren't enough people.

them.zh: 說得很好！謝謝你今天的分享。
them.py: Shuō de hěn hǎo! Xièxie nǐ jīntiān de fēnxiǎng.
them.en: Well said! Thanks for sharing today.

turns.task: Thank the host — happy to chat anytime.

ans.zh: 謝謝主持人！歡迎隨時找我聊！
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén! Huānyíng suíshí zhǎo wǒ liáo!
ans.en: Thank you! Happy to chat anytime!

vocab.n: Body part + 痛: 頭痛, 肚子痛. The doctor's first question: 哪裡痛？
Animals take the measure word 隻 zhī and the pronoun 牠.

x: Wǒ jiā de māo hěn ài shuìjiào.

vocab.n: 保重身體 bǎozhòng shēntǐ = take care of yourself — the caring goodbye.

x: Nǐ yíge xīngqí yùndòng jǐ cì?
How many times a week do you exercise?
Swimming in summer feels the best.

vocab.n: 肚子餓 = hungry; 肚子痛 = stomachache. Both daily essentials.

x: Kàn diànnǎo tài jiǔ, yǎnjīng hǎo lèi.
Too long at the computer — my eyes are exhausted.
Zhè jiā cāntīng yào xiān yùyuē.
vocab.n: Mainland often 預定/約. Taiwan: 預約 for clinics, salons, restaurants.

x: Chī tài duō tián de, yáchǐ huì tòng.
Too many sweets and your teeth will hurt.
Wǒ měi bàn nián kàn yícì yáyī.
I see the dentist every six months.
vocab.n: NHI covers basic dental — cleanings cost pocket change in Taiwan.

x: I'll check the documents once more.
vocab.n: Works for health checks, document review, and equipment inspection alike.

x: Qǐng jǐnkuài huífù zhè fēng xìn.
Please reply to this email as soon as possible.
vocab.n: Email register. Casual chat uses 回 alone: 你怎麼沒回我？

x: 時間確認以後我通知你。
Shíjiān quèrèn yǐhòu wǒ tōngzhī nǐ.
I'll let you know once the time is confirmed.
Is there a discount for volume?
vocab.n: 打折 is the verb (打九折 = 10% off); 折扣 is the noun you negotiate.

x: Zhège yuè de dìngdān zēngjiā le.
vocab.n: 下訂單 = to place an order.

x: The new plant is expected to finish next year.
vocab.n: News-register 'expected to'; spoken Chinese says 應該會.
The news way to say 一直. 持續成長 = sustained growth — you'll see it daily in CNA.

x: 星期一早上，我整個人很厭世。
Xīngqí yī zǎoshang, wǒ zhěngge rén hěn yànshì.
Monday morning — I'm completely done with the world.
slang.n: Taiwan youth staple; there's a whole 厭世 aesthetic of deadpan misery memes.

x: He's late AGAIN — I'm so mad!
slang.n: Taiwan internet: baby-talk spelling of 生氣氣. Fake-angry, never actually threatening.

x: 天氣一直變，小心破病喔！
Tiānqì yìzhí biàn, xiǎoxīn phò-pēnn o!
The weather keeps flipping — don't get sick!
slang.n: Hokkien for 生病; what your Taiwanese coworkers' moms text them every cold front.

slang.e: corporate livestock — an overworked wage slave
x: 為了訂單天天加班，標準社畜。
Wèile dìngdān tiāntiān jiābān, biāozhǔn shèchù.
Overtime every day for the orders — textbook corporate livestock.
slang.n: Japanese 社畜 by way of the internet; fluent currency among young workers in both Taiwan and China.

x: Xiàyǔ tiān ràng wǒ yǒudiǎn emo.
Rainy days get me in my feelings.
slang.n: Mainland internet usage of the English word, now pan-Chinese: 我 emo 了 = I'm feeling down.
